title: Managed Database: retention statement reconciliation — protected capacity limit
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database retention statement reconciliation uses the following protected capacity limit basis. External protected capacity is the smaller of measured retained quantity and active Managed Backup included capacity; it does not create a second native allowance.

## Capacity case
Hypothetical inputs: measured retention of 80 GB-month and protection capacity of 50 GB-month produce a protected capacity limit of 50 GB-month. Increasing only the hypothetical protection capacity to 90 GB-month makes the limit 80 GB-month.
